title: IIC Convener / Coordinator / ARIIA-NIRF nodal officer
question: Walk me through the last NIRF innovation submission you filed, start to finish. Where did you begin?
probe: What was open on your screen? What was next to it?
falsifies: If they begin from a single system that already holds a venture list, the 'no venture register' gap is smaller than Phase 1 concluded.

title: IIC Convener / Coordinator / ARIIA-NIRF nodal officer
question: In that same submission, you had to record a TRL for each innovation. Where did the DPIIT registration number come from?
probe: Did you ask the founder? Look it up on the DPIIT portal? Did someone else give you a list?
falsifies: Resolves OQ-32. Determines whether the product is a better spreadsheet or a workflow carrier.

title: IIC Convener / Coordinator / ARIIA-NIRF nodal officer
question: When you could not find a DPIIT number for a startup, what did you actually type into the cell?
probe: Did you leave it blank, put a placeholder, or drop the row entirely?
falsifies: Explains the DIPP0000 placeholders in 3 real forms.

title: IIC Convener / Coordinator / ARIIA-NIRF nodal officer
question: How long did that whole submission take you, and how much of it was re-work?
probe: Roughly how many hours? Was there a point where you had to redo rows?
falsifies: P-A08 grades hand-assembly DOCUMENTED; this tests whether it is felt as rework.

title: IIC Convener / Coordinator / ARIIA-NIRF nodal officer
question: What do you use between cycles to keep track of these startups - before the form asks you to?
probe: Excel? Google Sheets? WhatsApp groups? A register someone else maintains?
falsifies: P-A01 asks whether institutions keep a venture register at all.

title: IIC Convener / Coordinator / ARIIA-NIRF nodal officer
question: Is that spreadsheet yours, or does it come from someone else in the institute?
probe: Who else edits it? Does the Registrar see it?
falsifies: Tests whether Convener and Incubation Manager are one person, and whether data flows upward.

title: IIC Convener / Coordinator / ARIIA-NIRF nodal officer
question: When ARIIA asks for a similar count a few weeks later, do you reuse the same list?
probe: Have you ever compared the two numbers?
falsifies: If they reuse and reconcile, the duplication problem is weaker than claimed.

title: IIC Convener / Coordinator / ARIIA-NIRF nodal officer
question: You asked for Rs 1.2 lakh for something. Where did that number come from?
probe: Did you compare it to something you already spend, or was it a guess?
falsifies: Tests whether the price band is anchored to anything real.

title: Registrar / Dean (ICSR) / Controller of Examinations-adjacent office
question: Does the institute's official record of startups come to you, or do you go and get it?
probe: Who compiles it? How often? In what format?
falsifies: P-A10 documents consolidation by hand; this tests who owns the output.

title: Registrar / Dean (ICSR) / Controller of Examinations-adjacent office
question: Last time an annual report or NIRF filing needed innovation numbers, what did you do with them?
probe: Did you chase anyone? Did you get them once or repeatedly?
falsifies: P-A04 says one coordinator is the integration point for several problems.

title: Registrar / Dean (ICSR) / Controller of Examinations-adjacent office
question: Which budget head would a Rs 1-2 lakh annual software purchase come from?
probe: Have you approved anything in this range? Under which head?
falsifies: OQ-29 asks exactly this. Phase 0 has no answer.

title: Registrar / Dean (ICSR) / Controller of Examinations-adjacent office
question: Walk me through the last software purchase you approved. What was the route?
probe: Was there a committee? GeM? Direct purchase? How many weeks?
falsifies: Tests whether the Rs 50K-Rs 10L committee spread is reality.

title: Registrar / Dean (ICSR) / Controller of Examinations-adjacent office
question: What would make you NOT approve this?
probe: Is there a security questionnaire? A data-localisation clause?
falsifies: OQ-30 asks whether IT Admin has a veto.

title: Registrar / Dean (ICSR) / Controller of Examinations-adjacent office
question: Is there an existing system that already holds this, and why wasn't it used?
probe: ERP? Student information system? Existing software renewal?
falsifies: If a paid system already exists, the incumbent is not free.

title: Purchase Committee member / IT Administrator / Finance officer
question: What falls below a committee, and what goes to it?
probe: Is there a de-minimis threshold? Has it changed?
falsifies: Confirms or breaks the documented Rs 50K-Rs 10L spread.

title: Purchase Committee member / IT Administrator / Finance officer
question: If a vendor must store venture data on their own servers, who signs that off?
probe: Has anyone ever refused a purchase on security grounds?
falsifies: Resolves whether IT Admin has a real veto.

title: Purchase Committee member / IT Administrator / Finance officer
question: What security documents do you require from a software vendor?
probe: SOC 2? ISO 27001? Data localisation? Government cloud only?
falsifies: Tests whether on-premise/data-localisation is universal.

title: Student founder / incubator participant
question: After your startup was recognised, did anyone at the institute ask you for anything - a form, a number, a report?
probe: Did you get asked for your DPIIT number? Did you have to dig for it?
falsifies: Tests the founder side of the join-key problem.

title: Student founder / incubator participant
question: Is there any place you can see what stage your own startup is at, that the institute also sees?
probe: Or is it only the institute that tracks it?
falsifies: P-A06 grades stock-not-movement DOCUMENTED.

title: Student founder / incubator participant
question: When your institute filed a report that mentioned you, did it get anything wrong?
probe: Did you correct it? Did anyone notice?
falsifies: Tests whether the ledger is wrong about real startups.

title: Student founder / incubator participant
question: What do you personally use to keep track of your startup right now?
probe: Notes app? WhatsApp? Google Sheets? Nothing?
falsifies: Tests the 'free incumbent' claim from the user side.
